<!-- Receives in its environment a variable called `current_subjid`, `idx` and `params` -->
<!-- To be expanded gsubed so {{IDX}} is replaced by the index of the subject -->

```{r patient-profile-{{IDX}}, results='asis'}
# Section str location depends on the
section_str <- sprintf("\\section{Patient Profile %s}\n\n", current_subjid)
cat("\\pagestyle{headings}\n\n")

local({
  summary_res <- dv.papo:::pt_get_summary_data(
    params[["dataset_list"]][[params[["subject_level_dataset_name"]]]],
    params[["subjid_var"]],
    params[["summary"]][["vars"]],
    current_subjid
  )

  latex <- dv.papo:::batcher_pt_summary_to_latex(summary_res, section_str)

  if (latex[["present"]]) {
    section_str <<- ""
  }

  cat(latex[["content"]])
})

local({
  latex <- dv.papo:::batcher_pt_listings_to_latex(
    current_subjid,
    params[["subjid_var"]],
    params[["dataset_list"]],
    params[["listings"]],
    section_str,
    "patient-listing-{{IDX}}"
  )

  if (latex[["present"]]) {
    section_str <<- ""
  }

  cat(latex[["content"]])
})

local({
  plots_and_messages <- dv.papo:::batcher_pt_plots_to_plot_and_messages(
    current_subjid,
    params[["subjid_var"]],
    params[["subject_level_dataset_name"]],
    params[["dataset_list"]],
    params[["plots"]]
  )

  grobs <- dv.papo:::batcher_plots_to_grobs_and_heights(plots_and_messages)

  chunks <- dv.papo:::batcher_grobs_and_heights_to_chunks(grobs, "patient-plot-{{IDX}}", section_str)

  if (chunks[["present"]]) {
    section_str <<- ""
  }

  cat(chunks[["content"]])

  messages <- dv.papo:::batcher_plot_messages_to_latex(plots_and_messages[["messages"]], section_str)

  if (messages[["present"]]) {
    section_str <<- ""
  }

  cat(messages[["content"]])
})

cat("\\pagestyle{plain}\n\n")

if (!identical(section_str, "")) {
  cat(sprintf("\\section{Patient Profile %s}\n\nEmpty Participant\n\n", current_subjid))
}
```
